name: Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France (CC BY 2.0 FR)
content:
The word pair counts in ime/dict/latin/en.bigrams.txt and nl.bigrams.txt are derived from the Tatoeba sentence collection (https://tatoeba.org), by the Tatoeba contributors, which is published under the Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France license. Ownkey counts which words follow which in those sentences; it does not ship the sentences themselves.
